units: <cite ref="Pesachim 66a:6">Pes. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>התחיל מְקַנְטְרָן בדברים</he> he began to chide them with words; Y. ib. VI, 33ᵃ <he>מקנתרן</he>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:7">Cant. R. to IV, 7</cite> <he>מפני שקִינְטְרָן ולפי וכ׳</he> because he rebuked them, and as they took their father’s rebuke (in silence), they were allowed to be recorded side by side with Aaron &c.; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:12">Num. R. s. 13</cite> <he>שקִינְתְּרָן</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:12">Ib.</cite> <he>בירך … ומְקַנְתֵּר וכ׳</he> he blessed the tribes (his sons) and chided Reuben &c.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:4:5">Y. Sot. I, 16ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מבריחן … ומקנתרן בקלה</he> would he let them escape (unrebuked) from the heavier sin, and rebuke them for the lighter? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:6:6">Y. Snh. VII, 24ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מבריחו … ומְקַנְתְּרוֹ וכ׳</he> you cannot forego his heavier offence, and rebuke (punish) him for the lighter; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 1:8">Sifré Deut. 1</cite> <he>נ׳ עלי ר״ע וכ׳</he> R. Ak. was rebuked on my account before R. G. &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 789">Yalk. ib. 789</cite>.

senses.gloss: to make one’s self disagreeable; to vex.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11:7">Num. R. s. 11</cite> <he>מִתְקַנְטְרִים לפניהם וכ׳</he> they (the angels of destruction) vex them (the wicked) and say, ‘no peace’ &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 711">Yalk. ib. 711</cite>.
